name: @chanlievet/api
description: API REST + WebSockets (Express, Socket.io, Prisma) de ChanlieVet

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild prisma/seed.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/seed.js
scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force && prisma db seed
